description: This file is a PHP unit test class for testing the functionality of the ModelTrait used in serializers within the OrangeHRM project. It defines test cases for entity to array conversion, filtering, attribute naming, nested array creation, and interaction with nested entities such as 'TestEmployeeEntity' and 'TestJobTitleEntity'. It also includes mock entity and model classes used specifically for testing purposes.

classes.name: ModelTraitTest
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying the behavior of ModelTrait in serializable models, including nested entity handling and filter configurations.

classes.name: TestJobTitleEntity
classes.description: Mock entity representing a job title with properties 'name' and 'description' used for testing.

classes.name: TestEmployeeEntity
classes.description: Mock entity representing an employee with properties 'id' and 'jobTitle', where 'jobTitle' is a nested entity.

classes.name: TestJobTitleModel
classes.description: Test model implementing Normalizable, utilizing ModelTrait, for the TestJobTitleEntity, with methods to set filters and attribute mappings.

classes.name: TestEmployeeModel
classes.description: Test model implementing Normalizable, utilizing ModelTrait, for the TestEmployeeEntity, with methods to set filters and attribute mappings.

classes.name: TestModel
classes.description: A generic test class implementing Normalizable with the ModelTrait used for testing internal private methods such as 'makeNestedArray'.

methods.name: testSetEntity
methods.description: Tests setting an entity and converting it to an array to verify key filtering.

methods.name: testSetFilters
methods.description: Tests setting filters on the model and verifying the resultant array.

methods.name: testSetAttributeNames
methods.description: Tests setting attribute names and verifying the output array with renamed keys.

methods.name: testToArrayWithChaining
methods.description: Tests nested entity serialization, attribute and filter configurations, and array output.

methods.name: testMakeNestedArray
methods.description: Tests the private method 'makeNestedArray' for correctly constructing nested arrays from given paths and values.
